source_caption:
FX has ordered Legends, a meta-thriller limited series created by Charlie Hunnam that reunites the original Sons of Anarchy cast to play fictionalized versions of themselves facing a real-world threat at a fan convention.

The story follows the actors from the original series at a fan convention more than a decade after the show ended, when the line between real life and fiction blurs and they must face a real-world threat more dangerous than anything they experienced on the show.The series was developed by Hunnam and Jonathan Groff, who serve as executive producers alongside Rob Mac, Nicholas Frenkel, and Jackie Cohn. However Sons of Anarchy creator Kurt Sutter is not involved in the project.
